title: Ali and the Kite
text:
Ali has a new kite. It is red and big. He flies the kite in the park with his dad. The kite goes high in the sky.

Ali's friend Zeynep has a yellow ball. She likes to play football. Zeynep and Ali play together after school. They are always happy.

questions.text: What does Zeynep like to play?
Why is Ali probably happy at the park?
options: He has a kite that flies high

questions.text: Why do Ali and Zeynep probably like to play after school?

vocabulary.definition: a light toy that flies in the air on a string
a public place with grass and trees where people can play
the color of the sun or a lemon

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin yeni bir uçurtması var. Kırmızı ve büyük. Uçurtmayı babasıyla parkta uçurur. Uçurtma gökyüzünde çok yükselir.
Ali'nin arkadaşı Zeynep'in sarı bir topu var. Zeynep futbol oynamayı sever. Zeynep ve Ali okuldan sonra birlikte oynar. Onlar her zaman mutludur.
